question: Should the companion app establish a persistent network telemetry exporter and shared future-instrumentation API, including plaintext HTTP endpoints, and what data may those exporters send?
rationale: Correctness tests cannot decide the permanent privacy, transport, dependency, and future instrumentation contract introduced by this feature.

options.title: Approve a constrained telemetry contract
options.body: Define allowed data and endpoint rules, fix the connection-state semantics, and require complete current-head UI and both-protocol proof before merge.

options.title: Restrict transport or exporter scope
options.body: Allow only approved endpoints such as HTTPS or loopback HTTP and narrow the long-lived subscriptions before accepting the feature.

options.title: Defer network telemetry
options.body: Keep the existing local logs and diagnostic bundles and postpone this exporter surface until a broader instrumentation policy is established.

recommendation.title: Approve a constrained telemetry contract
recommendation.body: Define allowed data and endpoint rules, fix the connection-state semantics, and require complete current-head UI and both-protocol proof before merge.
